# Lib.io.file

## Operators

- [**AssimpExport**](AssimpExport.md) — Writes a mesh, a polygon geometry or a point cloud to a 3D file with Assimp.
- [**FilesInFolder**](FilesInFolder.md) — Scans a folder for all existing files and creates a list that can be used with [PickFromStringList]
- [**ReadFile**](ReadFile.md) — Reads a file on the local disk and outputs the content as a string
- [**WriteToFile**](WriteToFile.md) — Writes the incoming string into a predefined file on the local disk
